items.title_en: Prophet of Doom claims 'five-country war' will explode by end of the year
items.title_zh: 末日先知声称“五国战争”将在今年年底爆发
items.summary_en: A catastrophic conflict between at least five nations will erupt before the year is out, according to a bloke dubbed 'the Prophet of Doom'. Also known as the 'new Nostradamus', Craig Hamilton-Parker has a decent track record when it comes to predicting global events - so it seems we might ought to brace for battle. According to his latest prediction, several countries will be locked in a bloody battle by the end of 2026. Although you might be tempted to immediately characterise Hamilton-Parker's forecast as utter…
items.summary_zh: 一位被称为“末日先知”的人表示，今年年底前，至少五个国家之间将爆发一场灾难性冲突。克雷格·汉密尔顿·帕克也被称为“新诺查丹玛斯”，在预测全球事件方面有着不错的记录——所以看来我们应该做好战斗准备。根据他的最新预测，到 2026 年底，多个国家将陷入一场血战。
